verdict.rationale: The official README documents a non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly install path (`npx skills add <repo> --skill <name> -g -a claude-code -y`) that pre-selects the skill, scope and agent so no prompts are needed. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed the CLI runs keylessly via `npx -y`, detected it was being driven by Claude Code, and switched to promptless mode on its own. missing for 10: a recorded hands-on run of a full install completing to disk, and in-depth documentation of the `-y`/agent-detection behavior beyond a single example line.
